Support modules (constants, satellite data I/O, plotting)¶

Three support modules that the rest of the simulator leans on: the constants/lookup tables, the TLE read/write/generate code, and the static plotting helpers.

Constants¶

Summary¶

Constants is the single place for the numbers and tables the project shares. It groups:

Table 25: What it holds¶

Group

Contents

Unit

Physical constants

speed of light, Boltzmann constant, Earth GM, WGS-84 radii, flattening.

SI

GNSS signals

BANDS_CENTER_FREQUENCIES_Hz (carriers), GNSS_EIRP_DBW (transmit EIRP), GNSS_CHIP_RATE_HZ (code rate), BAND_TO_CONSTELLATION.

Hz, dBW

Data paths

every DATA/, OUTPUT/ and ephemeris folder, built from the working directory.

–

Important

Every path is built from os.getcwd(), so the simulator must be launched from the repo root or the data and output lookups break.

The lookup helpers turn a band name into its transmit EIRP or code chip rate:

class object_definitions.Constants_def.Constants[source]¶

Central store of physical constants, GNSS signal tables, and data-folder paths.

Holds the unit conversions and physical constants, the GNSS band carrier frequencies, the transmit-EIRP and code-chip-rate tables per (constellation, band), and every DATA and output folder path (each built from the current working directory). The lookup classmethods below resolve EIRP and chip rate for a band.

classmethod get_tx_eirp_dbw(constellation, frequency_hz, freq_tolerance_hz=1000000.0)[source]¶

Return the transmit EIRP [dBW] for constellation at carrier frequency_hz.

Reverse-looks-up the constellation-specific band name from BANDS_CENTER_FREQUENCIES_Hz (within freq_tolerance_hz), then indexes GNSS_EIRP_DBW[constellation][band]. Raises KeyError with a clear message if the constellation is unknown or has no EIRP entry at this frequency.

Parameters:

  • constellation (str)

  • frequency_hz (float)

  • freq_tolerance_hz (float)

Return type:

float

Caution

GNSS_EIRP_DBW values are scenario assumptions, not a traceable per-spacecraft antenna/link calibration. G1 and G2 use nominal GLONASS carrier centres and do not model FDMA channel offsets. Absolute received-power work should replace these tables with signal-, channel- and transmitter-specific values.

Satellite data I/O¶

Summary¶

ReadWriteSatData converts between the simulator’s orbits and TLEs (Two-Line Element Sets, the standard text format for satellite orbits). It generates a TLE from an Orbit_specification (solving for the SGP4 mean elements that reproduce the requested osculating orbit), reads TLE files into satellite records, and can download fresh TLEs.

Table 26: Key public methods¶

Method

What it does

Build a three-line TLE string from a satellite’s orbit.

read_tle_data(tle_file_path)

Parse a TLE file into per-satellite records.

Fetch and read a TLE file.

Plotting¶

Summary¶

Static_classes_def holds the Plotting class – static helpers that draw reflection traces and orbits over a map, plus an interactive 3-D globe export. They are visualization-only and read the same Natural Earth land/ocean data used elsewhere.

Table 27: Key methods¶

Method

What it does

plot_reflection_traces_gnss_const(...)

Draw the reflection tracks for each GNSS constellation.

plot_reflection_traces_total(...)

Draw the combined reflection tracks.

plot_orbits(sat_const)

Plot the satellite orbits.
class object_definitions.Static_classes_def.Plotting[source]¶

Module Assumptions and Limitations¶

  • Working directory matters. Constants resolves all paths from the current directory; run from the repo root.

  • Auto-generated TLEs have no drag. ReadWriteSatData writes TLEs without a B* drag term, so long propagations drift (see the satellites page).

  • Signal tables are simplified. EIRP entries are fixed per constellation/band and GLONASS G1/G2 use nominal rather than channel-specific frequencies.

  • Plotting is headless. The plotting helpers force a non-interactive backend and write files; they are not part of the physics path.

Validation and Tests¶

Test module

What it pins

tests/test_read_write_sat_data.py

TLE parsing snapshots and derived orbital quantities.

tests/test_satellite.py

Generated TLE files exist and are loadable; multi-record index/name selection keeps metadata and Skyfield propagation aligned.

tests/test_constants_eirp.py / band lookups in tests/test_delay_doppler.py

The EIRP and chip-rate lookups resolve correctly and cover every EIRP band.
